question: How often does the same finite interacting-vacuum profile search return an improvement at least as large as the observed Delta chi2 under the saved fitted-flat LCDM BAO null?
hypothesis: A one-rate extension may improve a finite profile by chance under a fitted-flat null; repeat the complete model search on provenance-fixed correlated mock vectors to measure this procedure-specific frequency.
assumptions_and_units: Fixed fitted-flat-LCDM mean and exact full-covariance Gaussian 13-vector null; generator is PCG64 standard normal followed by lower-Cholesky multiplication.
For each realization, rerun flat and interacting background profiles with finite search bounds and positive-component feasibility through z<=2.33.
Statistic is finite-search Delta chi2 = chi2_flat - chi2_selected_interaction, with nested-flat fallback in the selected score.
This is not a posterior p-value, model evidence, discovery significance, full search-across-models calibration, or physical/CMB validation.
environment_lock: Python 3.12.3, NumPy 2.5.3, SciPy 1.18.1; Linux x86_64; one BLAS/OpenMP thread per process

nuisance_parameters.alpha: analytically GLS-profiled; no separate H0/rd inference

training_validation_holdout_definition: Pilot indices: seeds 20260924 and 20260925, indices 0–19 each. Extension: seed 20260924 indices 20–199; seed 20260925 indices 20–999. The pooled audit verifies 1,200 unique nonoverlapping records and exact regenerated vectors.
covariance_order_and_overlap_treatment: Exact released 13x13 covariance and source row order retained for mock generation and every refit; no overlapping new Ly-alpha likelihood is added.
hardware: 20 CPU worker processes, 20 CPUs in affinity, one numerical thread each; CPU-only, no GPU
metric_definition: Count pooled selected mock Delta chi2 >= observed Delta chi2=1.5171630696615157; report exact two-sided Clopper-Pearson interval and empirical linear quantiles.
uncertainty: Exact two-sided binomial interval quantifies Monte Carlo uncertainty in this one fitted-flat finite-search bootstrap; not a posterior interval or calibrated significance.
attempts_counted_in_search: 1,160 new records; each flat fit uses 16 deterministic starts, each interaction fit 39 deterministic starts, plus 41x41 grid/refinement and exact nested-flat selected-score fallback; the 40 disjoint pilot records add to n=1,200.
interpretation_and_limits: The observed improvement is common under this particular fitted-flat, finite-search, late-time BAO background null. Calibration does not account for selecting among other cosmological models and is not full physical validation.
independent_reviewer: work/data_audit3/audit_interaction_null.py regenerated every mock vector and audited score/status/fallback calculations; eight saved fits were checked with the independent adaptive-scalar implementation in work/theory4/.
review_disposition: PASS: full 1,200-row provenance/score/status audit and stratified independent numerical re-evaluations; no mock refits in audit.
next_test: Do not increase this null ensemble; physical background and full-covariance held-out redshift-bin predictive checks are more informative next steps.
